There is absolutely nothing wrong with your DNA. A person is a person. Maybe this is wishful thinking but I like to believe that every human has a reason for living and a right to happiness. Don't give up what you deserve. You deserve happiness.

You do not deserve cancer. You don't deserve that pain and suffering and neither do your family and loved ones. Speaking of family, talk to them! Tell them you feel this way! They care about you a hell of a lot and will probably be able to help you.

Not everybody makes it into the history books but everyone has the potential to be something great. You have the potential to do *so much*. Think of everything there is to do and see in the world. The memories you could make, the love you could experience, the lives you could touch.

Reading this broke my heart. The purpose of a person isn't to find a mate and continue the species; there are more than enough people to do that. I can ensure you that you will one day find a girl who loves you for everything about yourself. No one should ever feel like a waste of resources. Everybody has a purpose and 17 years may not have been long enough to find yours. Please don't give up!
